# Flametal shield

Internal ID: ShieldFlametal | Type: Shield | Source: Black forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Ashwood x20, Flametal x8, Asksvin hide x4 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Flametal shield is the sixth round shield, craftable from Ashlands materials.
It has less block power compared to the Flametal tower shield but can be used to parry enemy attacks.
